scripts.build: pnpm content:validate && node scripts/run-astro.mjs build && pnpm search:index && pnpm deploy:artifacts
scripts.worker:registry:sync:preview: pnpm worker:registry:sql && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 execute DB --config worker/wrangler.preview.jsonc --remote --file worker/registry/content-articles.sql
scripts.worker:registry:sync:production: pnpm worker:registry:sql && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 execute DB --config worker/wrangler.production.jsonc --remote --file worker/registry/content-articles.sql
scripts.worker:migrations:preview: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply DB --config worker/wrangler.preview.jsonc --remote
scripts.worker:migrations:production: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply DB --config worker/wrangler.production.jsonc --remote
scripts.check: pnpm content:validate && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:architecture
